concept.title: Is OpenV free? What happens to my data if that changes?

conbody.p: The hosted service is free while OpenV is in alpha, with every feature included; self-hosting is free for good under the open-source MIT License (which asks only that you keep OpenV's copyright and licence notice); and registered charities and open-source projects stay free on the hosted service (an open-source workspace's projects are published, as of their latest baseline, on the site's open-source page). The hosted service will come in four tiers: Single User (free, bring your own AI), and Business Lite, Business and Enterprise, which are coming soon. The pricing page describes each tier and lists the hosted-runner limits in force. There is no billing in the product today.
If hosted OpenV ever charges, your data will not be behind the paywall. Export and import stay available on every plan, and a JSON export restores into a self-hosted OpenV.
